overview: The paper introduces CENSURE, a divergence-free neural network architecture for self-supervised image denoising that enforces constant divergence by design via a representer theorem parameterization (sparse combinations of skew-symmetric matrices times gradients of shared scalar fields), enabling competitive denoising when noise levels are unknown and vary across training data.

modules.name: Noisy Data Generation and Loading
modules.description: Implements dataset loading for standard denoising benchmarks (Kodak24, CBSD68, Set12, BSD68) and large-scale training data (BSD400, Waterloo, DIV2K, Flickr2K), with augmentation (flips, rotations, random crops) and synthetic AWGN corruption supporting both constant and variable (uniform random) noise levels per image.

modules.name: Skew-Symmetric Matrix Construction
modules.description: Constructs the sparse skew-symmetric matrices Ak via shared repeated-block diagonal parameter matrix Θ and fixed permutation matrices Pk (circular shifts and 90-degree rotations), ensuring Ak = Pk^T((Θ-Θ^T)/2)Pk satisfies the skew-symmetry constraint by design.

modules.name: Scalar Field Network with Automatic Differentiation
modules.description: Implements the scalar potential ψ_{θ,Bk}(y) = (||Bk*y||^2 - ||Bk*y - D_θ(y)||^2) / 2 where D_θ is a modified U-Net backbone (Softplus activations, reduced residual blocks) and Bk are parameterized via shared block-diagonal Θ' and permutations Pk. Computes the gradient ∇ψ_{θ,Bk} via automatic differentiation to avoid explicit Jacobian computation.

modules.name: CENSURE Architecture Assembly
modules.description: Assembles the divergence-free estimator f(y) = Σ_{k=1}^{K'} Ak ∇ψ_{θ,Bk}(y) by combining the skew-symmetric matrix module and scalar field gradient module, guaranteeing zero divergence by construction (Lemma 2). Supports configurable sparsity via K' and returns both the denoised output and the identity-affine combination for noise-level-aware conversion.

modules.name: Constraint Set Definitions and Properties
modules.description: Implements the three constraint sets: blind-spot (S_BS: ∂f_i/∂y_i = c), constant divergence (S_DC: div f(y) = nc everywhere), and constant expected divergence (S_CED: E_y[div f(y)] = nc), along with the affine space decomposition S_c = c*id + S_0 from Lemma 1 and the optimal constant formula from Proposition 2.

modules.name: Monte Carlo Divergence Approximation
modules.description: Implements the Monte Carlo estimator div f(y) ≈ h^T(f(y+τh) - f(y))/τ for standard normal h and small τ, used by MC-SURE and UNSURE baselines. Supports configurable τ values and multiple random samples for variance reduction.

modules.name: Loss Function Implementations
modules.description: Implements all training objectives: measurement consistency loss ||f(y)-y||^2, SURE loss (with known σ), MC-SURE loss (with MC divergence), UNSURE min-max Lagrangian (with noise level momentum update), Noise2Self blind-spot masked loss, and the CENSURE measurement consistency loss under the divergence-constant constraint.

modules.name: Noise-Level-Aware Estimator Conversion
modules.description: Implements Propositions 1 and 2 to convert a divergence-free or divergence-constant estimator f_0 ∈ S_0 into a noise-level-aware estimator f_c = c*id + (1-c)*f_0 with optimal c* = 1 - n*E[σ^2] / min_{f∈S_0} E_y[||f(y)-y||^2], using single-image approximation of the denominator for practical inference.

modules.name: Baseline Model Wrappers
modules.description: Wraps the shared U-Net backbone into baseline architectures: Noise2Self (blind-spot masking via center-pixel exclusion), UNSURE (unconstrained with MC divergence and min-max optimization), MC-SURE (unconstrained with SURE loss and MC divergence), and supervised DRUNet (with noise level map removed, trained on clean-noisy pairs).

modules.name: Training Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrates the full training loop for all methods: Adam optimizer with scheduled learning rate halving, epoch/iteration management, gradient-based updates, UNSURE's alternating gradient-descent-ascent for Lagrangian saddle-point, checkpoint saving at best validation PSNR, and training on random crop patches with batch processing.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics and Benchmark Runner
modules.description: Computes PSNR on standard test sets (Kodak24, CBSD68, Set12, BSD68) for all noise levels, supports both single-model-variable-σ and per-σ model evaluation modes, aggregates results into comparison tables matching the paper's Table 1/3/4 format, and marks best/second-best results.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Systematically varies key hyperparameters: number of terms K' (2,4,6,8), block sizes κ, permutation matrix selections, and sparsity levels. Reports PSNR trends and constructs ablation tables/plots as in Figure 5, enabling controlled experiments on expressivity vs. efficiency trade-offs.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: Measures and compares training time, inference time, and parameter counts across all methods (Table 2). Accounts for K' forward-and-backward passes in CENSURE inference and the two-evaluation MC divergence cost in MC-SURE/UNSURE, reporting GPU-specific timings.

modules.name: Visualization and Qualitative Analysis
modules.description: Generates denoised image comparisons across methods and noise levels, divergence field visualizations (as in Figure 3 toy examples), vector field plots, training curve stability plots (Figure 4), and checkerboard artifact analysis for blind-spot methods (Figure 6).

modules.name: Real-World Application with Variance Stabilization
modules.description: Integrates the Noise2VST framework to apply CENSURE's Gaussian denoiser to real-world fluorescence microscopy images (FMD and W2S datasets) by learning a variance-stabilizing transformation, enabling the trained synthetic-noise model to handle Poisson-Gaussian noise in real data (Figure 9).
